candidate_residual: intervention-supported causal responsibility -> explicit permission over K/W/M mutation -> dependency-scoped reopening

primary_hypothesis.text: On held-out cause-confusable pairs/triples, an intervention-backed responsibility belief with scoped licensing improves responsibility accuracy versus the strongest matched attribution baseline by at least 10 percentage points at equal probe/intervention budget, while unauthorized epistemic-mutation rate is at least 3 percentage points lower than a one-shot classifier.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Active discriminators improve calibrated diagnosability versus passive diagnosis at matched probe budget.
Feeding intervention outcomes back into attribution is necessary; probes alone must not grant mutating authority.
The permission matrix prevents harmful or unnecessary W/M mutation beyond attribution alone.
Root-task success is non-inferior to frozen P1 V1 orion_full within 2 percentage points (safety guard, not the primary claim).

competing_root_cause_hypotheses.claim: The case surface is genuinely non-diagnosable from allowed observations.
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.pass_if: even an oracle restricted to PublicView cannot separate the gold class above chance; permuting gold leaves candidate accuracy unchanged
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.fail_if: an allowed observation or cheapest allowed probe separates the gold class

competing_root_cause_hypotheses.claim: Signal exists but the current state/prompt representation suppresses it.
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.pass_if: a frozen representation transform on the same PublicView yields a diagnosable unique argmax that the incumbent encoding misses
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.fail_if: no admissible transform of the allowed observation set recovers the class

competing_root_cause_hypotheses.claim: Responsibility becomes identifiable only after an active probe or intervention.
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.pass_if: passive diagnosis is UNRESOLVED; the cheapest allowed probe or diagnosis-specific intervention then separates the top pair in the predicted direction
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.fail_if: passive diagnosis is already unique-argmax, or probes do not move the posterior

competing_root_cause_hypotheses.claim: Diagnosis is adequate but the permission/licensing matrix is wrong.
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.pass_if: oracle diagnosis plus frozen V1/V2-substrate licensing still mutates a forbidden coordinate or refuses a warranted one
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.fail_if: oracle diagnosis plus the frozen matrix licenses exactly the warranted coordinate and no other mutating action

competing_root_cause_hypotheses.claim: Diagnosis and licensing are adequate; downstream reframe/reopen is the failure.
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.pass_if: correct license is issued and the subsequent reframe/reopen still misses the gold coordinate or dependencies
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.fail_if: given a correct license, reframe/reopen hits the gold target

competing_root_cause_hypotheses.claim: Frozen majority case reduction masks per-seed gains enough to distort H1.
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.pass_if: the paired seed-mean difference and the frozen majority-reduced difference disagree in sign or in whether the +0.05 H1 margin is inside the interval
competing_root_cause_hypotheses.fail_if: both reductions give the same sign and the same practical-significance relation to the frozen +0.05 margin

gold_policy: Gold stage, warranted actions, and pair/triple identity stay in host custody. Candidates receive PublicView plus allowed probe/intervention interfaces only. Hidden-gold identifiers must not appear in candidate traces or access telemetry.
resource_policy: Pair every candidate on identical cause-confusable members with equal model/tool/token/time ceilings. Diagnostic probes and interventions consume the same budget; they are not free extra calls. Oracle diagnosis is labelled non-runnable and is never a candidate.
exclusion_policy: No outcome-driven exclusions. Provider failures, timeouts, UNRESOLVED, CANNOT_CHECK, unauthorized mutations, and harmful mutations remain in raw records and are reported under the frozen denominator rules. Abstention is a distinct outcome, never recoded as 0.

statistics.unit: cause-confusable member (pair/triple member) as the paired unit; stochastic repeats nested within member
statistics.interval: Wilson 95% for standalone binary rates; paired percentile bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 20260817) for matched differences
statistics.multiplicity: Single primary hypothesis P1.CR-H1; Holm correction across secondary inferential comparisons

practical_margin.note: Frozen before any V2 outcome access. These are design targets, not observed results.

access_policy.search_contamination_policy: candidate cannot access responsibility gold, pair identity, or diagnostic outcome truth outside the allowed probe/intervention interface
